one_line_verdict: Strong product quality and support, held back by delivery, packaging and returns problems.
summary: Customers like the product quality, value and responsive support. Complaints focus on late deliveries, damaged packaging, an unstable order-tracking app and a confusing return process.
top_positives: Excellent product quality that matches the description
Easy setup and good value for the features
customer_pain_points: Delivery delays beyond the promised date
business_suggestions: Improve packaging and review courier performance
Fix the app crash and make tracking reliable
best_for: Users who want an easy setup
